title: Bee Removal in Stapleton, Staten Island
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket and carpenter bee nest removal in Stapleton, Staten Island. Licensed technicians treat and seal nests in walls, attics, eaves. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional stinging insect removal throughout Stapleton, Staten Island — treating and removing wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nests from homes and businesses. Our licensed technicians locate nests in wall voids, attics, soffits, chimneys, eaves, and the ground, treat the colony, remove accessible nest material, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization. Whether wasps have built a paper nest inside your wall or carpenter bees have bored galleries into your trim, we respond quickly to eliminate the nest and secure the structure.
whyUs: Our Stapleton bee removal specialists combine years of local experience with safe, effective removal techniques that protect both your property and the environment. We offer transparent pricing between $350 and $550, same-day emergency service, and a satisfaction guarantee that has made us Staten Island's most trusted pest control provider.
localContext: Stapleton's mix of historic Victorian homes, modern residential developments, and waterfront properties near Tappen Park and the Staten Island Railway creates ideal nesting sites for wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, and carpenter bees. The neighborhood's mature trees along Van Duzer Street and Bay Street Corridor, combined with older building structures, attract wasp and hornet colonies that nest in eaves, soffits, wall cavities, and attic spaces. Carpenter bees target the wooden trim, decks, and fascia boards common in Stapleton's older housing stock, drilling galleries that weaken the wood and invite repeat nesting seasons.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my Stapleton property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and emergency response throughout Stapleton and Staten Island. Most wasp, hornet, and yellow jacket nest treatments are completed within 1–3 hours, depending on the nest location and access. We understand that active nests near entry doors or living spaces create immediate danger, especially for anyone with sting allergies, so we prioritize rapid response to protect your family.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Stapleton?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: What types of stinging insects are common in Stapleton homes?
faqs.answer: Stapleton properties commonly experience wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee problems. Wasps and yellow jackets build paper nests in wall voids, attics, soffits, and underground burrows; bald-faced hornets construct large aerial nests in trees and under eaves. Carpenter bees bore into wooden structures like decks, fascia, eaves, and siding — the neighborhood's older homes are particularly vulnerable to carpenter bee gallery damage that worsens each season. Our inspection identifies the species and nest location, then determines the most effective treatment and sealing strategy for your structure.
